messages:
Lola P.: Hey team! Two bits of good news — I got promoted to Senior PM 🎉 and we adopted a tiny rescue cat over the weekend (meet Mochi) 🐾. Totally normal day, right?
Jamal: WHOA congrats!! :tada: Mochi pics pls.
Lola P.: Thanks!! Posting one: (image) — she’s a fluffball. Also quick q: thinking of doing a small, low-key celebration in the office on Friday at 3pm. Cupcakes? Savory snacks? Cat-themed cupcakes? 😂
Priya: Congrats Lola!! Love Mochi ❤️ Cupcakes + coffee always a yes from me.
Evan: Huge congrats!! Can we do mini empanadas instead? I will fight for empanadas.
Rachel: Congrats! I can bring a mini photo printout frame and sticky props for a Mochi photo corner. Also reminder — no animals in the office without frontline approval, so maybe bring plushie or photos instead?
Lola P.: Yup, totally — won’t bring Mochi to the office (she’s still tiny + nervous). Photo corner sounds perfect. If folks vote, I’ll order whatever wins.
hr-bot: Congrats Lola on your promotion! HR has updated your title in the directory. :confetti_ball:
Jamal: Poll: what should we get? 1) Cupcakes 🧁 2) Mini empanadas 🥟 3) Savory mini quiches 🥧 4) Cat-themed sugar cookies 🐱 (react to this message with the emoji to vote)
Priya: voted 🧁
Evan: voted 🥟
Rachel: voted 🐱
Lola P.: Thanks for the votes! Looks close — I’ll order a mix (cupcakes + a few empanadas) and coffee. Party Friday 3pm in kitchen. Mochi-themed sign courtesy of Rachel. :heart_eyes:
